units.source_text: 挂钟响了十下的时候，信子懒洋洋的抬起垂着的眼睑，说：“阿俊怎么还没回来呢。”

en.t: When the wall clock struck ten, Nobuko lazily lifted her drooping eyelids and said, "Why hasn't Shun come back yet?"

units.source_text: 照子听了姐姐的话，也看了一眼挂钟，却出乎意料的冷淡的说了一句“还没有”。

en.t: Hearing her sister's words, Teruko also glanced at the wall clock, but said with unexpected coldness, "Not yet."

units.source_text: 在照子的回复中，信子察觉到了沉浸在对丈夫餍足爱意的心绪。

en.t: In Teruko's answer, Nobuko sensed a heart steeped in satisfied love for her husband.

units.source_text: 想到这里，她的心情越发低沉。

en.t: Thinking of this, her spirits sank even lower.

units.source_text: 信子把下巴缩在合服的衬衣领子里，戏谑的说道。

en.t: Nobuko tucked her chin into the collar of her kimono undergarment and spoke teasingly.

units.source_text: 那自然流露的羡慕的语调，溢于言表。

en.t: The envy that naturally colored her tone was unmistakable.

units.source_text: 照子却入稚子般天真的笑着瞪了一眼姐姐：“你笑话我啦。”

en.t: Teruko, however, laughed with childlike innocence, shot her sister a look, and said, "You're teasing me."

units.source_text: 随后，她又马上撒娇的补充了一句，“姐姐过的也十分幸福呀。”

en.t: Then she immediately added in a coaxing voice, "You are very happy too, elder sister."

units.source_text: 正是这句话让信子受到了沉重的打击。

en.t: It was precisely those words that dealt Nobuko a heavy blow.
